translation: [#P04Accident] Occurred!
An "Accident” is a compulsory penalty event.

They occur when Haruhi Suzumiya arrives at
a red accident point…
…on the Haruhi Route on the top screen.

When an Accident occurs, the time limit will be
decreased substantially.
There are two ways to avoid Accidents.
[#P041]. Acquire the corresponding "Main Topic.”

[#P04]"Topic” is a general term for a keyword or
item that serves to distract Haruhi…
[#P04]…or temporarily hinder her progression.

[#P04You] can obtain them in events that occur
during the story, depending on your…

[#P04]…Brigade member allotment. By allotting your
Brigade members in different ways, you will…

[#P04]…have the opportunity to acquire various
differing topics.
[#P04There] are four types of Topics.
[#P04]"Main Topics” concern the story—

[#P04]"Haruhi Topics” concern the individual
characteristics of Haruhi Suzumiya—

[#P04]"Character Topics” concern the individual
characteristics of the SOS Brigade members—

[#P04And] "Sub-Topics” are snippets of casual
conversations. That concludes the four types.
[#P04Among] these, acquiring the Main Topic…

[#P04]…will allow you to automatically evade the
corresponding Accident.
[#P042]. Using a Haruhi Topic.

[#P04Depending] on Kyon's actions in the scene
following group member selection…

[#P04]…you may acquire a Haruhi Topic. In that
case…

[#P04]…you can use it on an Accident that would
normally be unstoppable without a Main Topic…
[#P04]…and forcibly evade it.

[#P04However], Haruhi Topics are more difficult to
obtain than the other Topics…
[#P04]…so please think carefully before using them.

[#P04To] compensate, the only Topics that will carry
over between episodes…
[#P04]…are Haruhi Topics.

[#P04If] there's nothing you can do to evade an
Accident, there's another available tactic.

[#P04Using] a Topic at an event point on the Haruhi
Route…
[#P04]…will trigger a Delay Event.

[#P04By] presenting a Topic keyword to Haruhi
Suzumiya…

[#P04]…it is possible to distract and delay her for a
short time.

[#P04The] time it can delay her for depends on the
details of the Topic and the combination of…

[#P04]…members grouped with Haruhi, but in general
the order is as follows:
[#P04Haruhi] Topic—Large time limit increase.

[#P04Character] Topic—Ordinary time limit
increase.
[#P04Sub]-Topic—Small time limit increase.

[#P04Haruhi] Topics also have the ability to negate
Accidents…

[#P04]…but by using them to delay her, you can
drastically increase the time limit.

[#P04Try] to get as many Topics as you can in the
Investigation Phase…

[#P04]…in order to increase your options in the
Puzzle Phase.

[#P04The] number of Topics you obtain and your
response to choices are both important, but…
[#P04]…allotting Brigade members is most important.

[#P04Please] identify the characteristics of each
member and after thinking carefully…

[#P04]…distribute them according to what each is
well-suited for.

[#P04The] behavior of the members who don't
accompany Kyon are also important factors.

[#P04Try] distributing group members in various
ways and find out which combos work best!
